tool_input.description: List users feature API files and find notification/queryKey usage

result:
I fixed both rule violations in the new code. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, and I did not commit.

- **Notification moved into the hook:** `apps/react-vite/src/features/users/api/update-user-role.ts` now calls `useNotifications()` and shows the "Role Updated" success notice in `onSuccess`, after the users query is invalidated and before the caller's `onSuccess` runs.
- **Component no longer touches notifications:** `apps/react-vite/src/features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx` no longer imports `useNotifications` and no longer passes an `onSuccess` through `mutationConfig`. It calls `useUpdateUserRole()` with no arguments.
- **Query key was already compliant:** the invalidation uses `getUsersQueryOptions().queryKey`, and the new code has no literal key arrays.

The existing feature components (`delete-user.tsx`, `update-profile.tsx`, the discussion and comment components) still call `addNotification` directly. That is outside this change, so I left it alone. Those would need the same move if you want the rule applied across the feature.
